'''Trechane''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sith Warrior]] who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]]. He was one of many [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] who were deployed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]] during the [[Invasion of Belsavis|Imperial invasion]].
